Ami.description: This is the schema definition for the Update Service. It represents the properties for the service itself and has links to collections of firmware and software inventory.
Ami.longDescription: This resource shall be used to represent an Update Service for a Redfish implementation. It represents the properties that affect the service itself.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

The configuration need to be preserved when doing firmware update or restore factory defaults.

CAFileModifiedDate.description: The last modification timestamp of the CA certificate file.

ClientFileModifiedDate.description: The last modification timestamp of the client certificate file.

EnableEapTLS.description: This property is used to indicate if the EnableEapTLS is Enabled or not.

GroupName1.description: The name of the remote group, or the remote role in the case of a Redfish Service, that maps to the local Redfish Role to which this entity links.

GroupName2.description: The name of the remote group, or the remote role in the case of a Redfish Service, that maps to the local Redfish Role to which this entity links.

GroupName3.description: The name of the remote group, or the remote role in the case of a Redfish Service, that maps to the local Redfish Role to which this entity links.

PrivateKeyFileModifiedDate.description: The last modification timestamp of the private key file.

Privilege1.description: This property is used to indicate if the Role is one of the Redfish Predefined Roles.

Privilege2.description: This property is used to indicate if the Role is one of the Redfish Predefined Roles.

Privilege3.description: This property is used to indicate if the Role is one of the Redfish Predefined Roles.

Secret.description: The Secret for this Service. A PATCH request writes the password. This property is `null` in responses.

ServiceAddress.description: This property specifies the host ServiceAddress in the range to the firewall rule

ServicePort.description: Property contains the Destination ServicePort number for the RADIUS service.

isCAFilePresent.description: Indicates whether the RADIUS CA certificate file is present on the system.

isClientCertPresent.description: Indicates whether the RADIUS client certificate file is present on the system.

isPrivateKeyPresent.description: Indicates whether the private key file required for EAP-TLS is present.
